skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Along the Corridor
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Along the Corridor. Made by Lungmen craftsmen from premium Shangshu silk. Elegant and classical patterns with cyan lining make for a dignified outfit.
skins.usage: One of Kroos the Keen Glint's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Green tiles in the morning mist, warm freeze on yellow flowers. Step through the halls, step with the song. —Kroos' first Yanese poem, translated

skins.name: The Apprentice and Her Aura
skins.content: Achievement Star Collection/The Apprentice and Her Aura. Clothes Kroos wore when receiving an award at a game expo. She'd just cleared some quests with her friends when she was picked as the lucky player. Wearing the dev-provided costume, she smiled widely at the camera.
skins.usage: One of Kroos the Keen Glint's stage outfits.
skins.quote: After they started playing 'Destiny Quest', Kroos set up an adventurer's guild with her friends called 'Here We Are' and started planning big plans for some large-scale hunting quests. However, looking at guides wasn't a part of those plans.
